proof.text: Construct the open adjunction by evaluation at the integral generator. Apply Hom(Q,-) to the localization sequence in an injective resolution. Injectivity makes the sequence degreewise exact. The closed-cone lift and Ext resolution comparison give the relative isomorphism with signed representative (zp(1),0). The counit triangle proves inclusion maps to one. Use the supported realization to define support.
